name: Material Data Agent
description: Specialist agent for retrieving and managing nuclear reactor material property data. Provides access to material specifications, historical performance data, and regulatory compliance information.

skills.name: List Materials
skills.description: List all available materials in the database with their basic info (ID, name, spec, max temperature, applications)
skills.usage_notes: Call this to discover what materials are available before requesting detailed data
skills.output_format: JSON array of materials with material_id, name, specification, max_temp, and applications

skills.name: Get Material Data
skills.description: Retrieve comprehensive material data including properties, specifications, operating environment, inspection history, and compliance status
skills.usage_notes: Always call this first to understand material properties before performing specialized analysis
skills.output_format: JSON with complete material record including mechanical properties, chemistry, operating conditions, and history

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material to retrieve (e.g., SS316, SS316L, SS304, SS347)

skills.name: Get Material Properties
skills.description: Retrieve specific material properties including mechanical, thermal, chemical, and physical characteristics
skills.usage_notes: Use when you need detailed material properties for analysis calculations
skills.output_format: JSON with mechanical properties (strength, ductility), thermal properties (conductivity, expansion), and chemical composition

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material

skills.name: Get Material History
skills.description: Retrieve historical performance data, inspection records, maintenance events, and operating history
skills.usage_notes: Use to understand degradation trends and previous issues
skills.output_format: JSON with inspection dates, findings, operating hours, failure events, and maintenance actions

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material

skills.name: Get Regulatory Limits
skills.description: Retrieve applicable regulatory limits, acceptance criteria, and compliance thresholds from NRC, ASME codes
skills.usage_notes: Use to check if analysis results meet regulatory requirements
skills.output_format: JSON with regulatory limits for damage, degradation rates, and safety factors

material_id.description: The unique identifier of the material
